upload.elevenlabs.title: Scribe v2 advanced options
upload.elevenlabs.description: These controls only appear for ElevenLabs. Premium extras stay disabled by default.
upload.elevenlabs.keyterms.label: Keyterm prompting
upload.elevenlabs.keyterms.help: Bias the model toward important brands, names, and domain terms. ElevenLabs pricing: +$0.05/hour on top of Scribe v2.
upload.elevenlabs.keyterms.constraints: Batch Scribe v2: up to 1000 keyterms, 50 characters per keyterm, up to 5 words. One per line or comma-separated.
upload.elevenlabs.entityDetection.label: Entity detection
upload.elevenlabs.entityDetection.help: Tag entities like names, dates, cards, emails, and addresses. ElevenLabs pricing: +$0.07/hour on top of Scribe v2.
upload.elevenlabs.entityDetection.custom: For custom mode, enter entity types one per line or comma-separated.
upload.elevenlabs.redaction.label: Entity redaction
upload.elevenlabs.redaction.help: Mask detected entities in the final transcript. Requires entity detection and uses the same entity-detection add-on, with no separate extra fee.
upload.elevenlabs.redaction.customHelp: Custom redaction should stay a subset of entity detection per ElevenLabs rules.
upload.elevenlabs.error.keytermsRequired: Keyterm prompting is enabled, but the keyterm list is empty.

upload.elevenlabs.error.redactionNeedsDe: Entity redaction only works when entity detection is enabled.
